title: Two concurrent beta sign-ins of one address call aMember once, even when one cache read returns after the other finished
steps: S1: From the repository root run: node --test --test-name-pattern='does not call the API again' apps/tracy-web/test/beta-operation-signal.test.mjs
S2: From the repository root run: node --test --test-name-pattern='entityLanguages|language' packages/cms/tracy-seeder/test/*.test.mjs
expect: S1: exit 0, 1 test passed, 0 failed: the fake membership API was called exactly once for two sign-ins whose cache reads were forced into the losing order.
S2: exit 0, 0 failed: entity languages read from the content map are unchanged by the per-file cache.
evidence: 12/10/2026: apps/tracy-web full suite on a loaded machine had `cache lasts 10 minutes, coalesces concurrent requests` red with 2 !== 1; the new test is red on the old beta-access.js (2 !== 1) and green on the fix
fence: The memory-cache re-read in membership() before calling the membership API
